name: Kaju Paneer
steps: Soak 70 g cashews in 120 ml hot water for 15 minutes. Blend with the soaking liquid into a smooth paste; reserve the remaining whole cashews for the finished curry.
Heat ghee and toast the reserved cashews for 2 minutes until golden; lift them out. In the same pan, fry onions for 7 minutes, then ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add tomato puree, coriander, chili and salt. Cook 9–10 minutes, stirring, until the tomato base is thick and glossy.
Stir in cashew paste and remaining water. Simmer gently for 5 minutes, then add paneer and cook 3–4 minutes just until hot.
Turn off heat, fold in cream and garam masala, and top with toasted whole cashews. Serve with roti.
tips: Reserve visible whole cashews for a distinct kaju paneer finish instead of blending all the nuts.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
